island.title: Tidewater Harbor
island.rule: Tide Organs shift the ocean between low, half, and high tide to reshape caves and canals, while your oarless skiff sails on lantern recoil and mooring swings.
island.feel: Brisk salt spray momentum paired with clever tidal engineering where water height changes everything.
island.arc: Arrive stranded at low tide, free your skiff, and sound the Tide Organ. Clear the Drowned Galleon and Smugglers' Locks in either order, survive the Leviathan's belly, climb the tidal Lighthouse with Prism Split, and face the Undertow.
moments: Grounding your empty skiff at low tide right on top of a submerged floor plate to weigh it down.
Pulling the ship capsize wheel to roll a hull room onto its side and flood it into a skiff canal.
Firing one blue bolt into a four portal loop that orbits forever to power twin capacitors.
Getting swallowed whole with your skiff by the Leviathan and blasting out its blowhole.
Splitting one bolt into three rays across mirrors and floating rafts inside the Lighthouse.

galleon.promise: A half sunk wooden warship whose rolling deck slides cargo, mirrors, and oil kegs from side to side across flooded bilges.
galleon.power: Ballast Clamp lets your thrown lantern pin sliding crates, mirrors, or kegs.
galleon.arc: Learn how shifting the ship's tilt moves crates and drains bilges, defeat the Bosun's Rig for Ballast Clamp, split linked cargo, capsize a hull into a canal, and face the Figurehead.
galleon.boss: The Figurehead swings across a listing bowsprit on an anchor chain. Clamp her anchor fluke to slam her nose first.

locks.promise: Twin terraced smuggling canals where sluice gates trade water between basins and blue portals warp both bolts and boats.
locks.power: Sluice Harpoon lets your lantern recall tow floating mirror rafts and sea mines.
locks.arc: Learn skiff recoil portals and linked lock water, defeat the Dredge Hulk for Sluice Harpoon, tow rafts through portals, tip a water scale, and build a perpetual bolt orbit before the Twins.
locks.boss: The Twin Lockmasters pass one shared shield through four portals while flipping canal water every twelve seconds.

leviathan.promise: A storm surge chase over flooded rooftops that ends inside a colossal whale's belly and launches you skyward through its blowhole.
leviathan.arc: Outrun the Leviathan's bow wave across rooftops, choose a breakwater route to ring the chum bell and get swallowed, solve the heartbeat bilge, defeat the Gullet Lamprey, and ride three blowhole geysers out.
leviathan.boss: The Gullet Lamprey coils around the whale's glowing heart. Light its three swallowed ship lanterns to flip it open.

lighthouse.promise: A four story tidal beacon where water height, floating mirror rafts, and three way prism rays link every floor vertically.
lighthouse.power: Prism Split turns a bounced bolt into a three ray blue fan.
lighthouse.arc: Light the first seabed relay, win Prism Split in the prism rotunda, beat the Tide Captain, witness a shadowy rival shatter a lamp, align the mirror drum, and climb to the Hermit.
lighthouse.boss: The Lighthouse Hermit sweeps a scorching beam across four mirrors. Reflect his beam back and clamp drifting mirrors.

overworld.promise: Untether your oarless skiff in Tidewater Harbor, sound the quay Tide Organs to reshape shoals and slips, and sail out toward the outer waters.
overworld.aha: Your bolt recoil drives the skiff while Tide Organs physically change which paths are dry or flooded.
checks: Did untethering the skiff and steering by bolt recoil click quickly?
Did sounding a Tide Organ visibly reshape where you could walk and sail?
Were the three beacons and outer sea exits easy to spot and reach?
